'''Kenrik Fost''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3631 BBY]] he was the captain of the [[Brekken Gang]] of Nikto. They have received order from [[Gault Rennow]] for obtaining a functional missile, with the trade-off scheduled at [[Vandin]]. However, Gault's partner [[Vette]] managed to sneak inside the missile and sabotage it. When Gault arrived, he refused to pay for the whole missile and activated its warhead, prompting Kenrik Fost and his men to run.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kenrik Fost appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' '''Chapter 13: Profit and Plunder'''.<ref name="SWTOR" />
